''See also: [[Ekeri Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ekeri, also known as [[Ekerinatoth]] of the [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]], was a [[Truegold dragon]] who pursued [[Lindon]] under the suspicion that he possessed treasures from [[Ghostwater]]. During their confrontation, she utilized a portable shelter and various tools from her [[void key]], including furniture and whips made of [[Forged madra]] or liquid gold. Despite her agility and ability to manipulate [[fire aura]], she was ultimately killed by [[Lindon]] when his [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] speared through her chest. Following her death, she was transformed into a [[Remnant]]. This golden-armored dragon [[Remnant]] serves as a guardian of her former territory and possesses the ability to use numerous [[launcher construct|launcher constructs]]. The [[Remnant]] has also shown progress in gaining the ability to manifest a human form, with her foreclaws beginning to resemble hands. A life-size [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] statue of Ekeri was also created by the [[Heart Sage]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ekeri is the little sister of [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] and maintains a close connection to [[Underlord]]. She was an adversary of [[Lindon]], whom she fought and intended to kill before he eventually killed her and bound her as a dragon spirit [[Remnant]].}}
